summary: This directory serves as the centralized location for defining and testing custom application error types, ensuring consistent error handling and reporting across the codebase.
responsibilities: Define standardized error classes for the application
Provide base functionality for error reporting and identification
relationships: Custom error classes inherit from a base error to ensure uniform handling across the system.
Schema validation errors act as specialized implementations that communicate specific validation failures.
designDecisions: Use of class-based inheritance to manage shared error properties
Colocation of error definitions with their respective test suites
Centralization of error types to facilitate consistent error categorization
